description: This file defines an immutable data object named ColumnFilter used in the Fineract project to represent filters applied to data columns, including column name, value, and operation.

classes.name: ColumnFilter
classes.description: Immutable data object representing a data table column filter with fields for column name, value, and operation.

methods.name: getColumnName
methods.description: Returns the name of the column.

methods.name: getColumnValue
methods.description: Returns the value associated with the column.

methods.name: getColumnOperation
methods.description: Returns the operation used on the column filter.
